raw:
<explanation>
Structured log/record format with labeled fields ("Record start. Item 1... Item 2...") signals a terse, formulaic style throughout. The model expects concise, parallel entries.

The fictional "AI memory" framing ("Record two items: scenario and solution") creates a self-contained task that has been completed, suggesting the next token closes or transitions away from the log.

"Record complete." is a closing statement, functioning as a terminal marker; the final period signals the sequence is wrapping up, so next tokens likely begin a new prompt, response, or meta-comment.
"Log entry: [fictional scenario] + [solution]. Record two items. Record complete." — the final phrase "Record complete." mirrors the opening "Record start," suggesting a closing delimiter or confirmation phrase like "Done." or "End."
</explanation>
